abstract: Best practices for @hellajs/headless, the behavior package: renderer-free wiring utils (focus traps, dismissal layers, anchor positioning, hover timing, pointer gestures) plus the headless component factories - popover, dialog, menu, tooltip, combobox, select, command, toggles, tabs, toast, calendar, form - that render structure, never styles, with state in the caller's signals. Every rule is grounded in the package source and test suite.
